Definition: Galil (as a special circuit) in the North of Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Galilee = "circuit, district"; 1) a territory in Naphtali largely occupied by heathen; a circuit of towns around Kedesh-Naphtali, in which were situated the 20 towns given by Solomon to Hiram king of Tyre as payment for his work in conveying timber from Lebanon to Jerusalem
